stories.title: N.S. election speculation swirls as Tim Houston government launches new website
stories.summary: Speculation around a potential provincial election is swirling around Nova Scotia, as Tim Houston's PC government launches a new website outlining a plan for the province.

stories.title: Nova Scotia paying $31K a month for stalled New Waterford health-care centre project
stories.summary: The NDP says it has obtained documents showing the PC government has been paying a construction company $31,555 a month for a health-care centre project that has been paused.

stories.title: Man accused of racist tirade caught on video in a Halifax box store pleads not guilty
stories.summary: The lawyer for 37-year-old Randall Publicover pleaded on behalf of his client in Halifax provincial court today.

stories.title: Pause on Cape Breton AI data centre needed, new Nova Scotia Liberal leader says
stories.summary: Nova Scotia's new Liberal leader is demanding stronger regulation around a planned AI data centre in Cape Breton and is calling for the premier to put the project on hold.

stories.title: N.S. RCMP recovered cockpit voice recorder of downed Ontario air ambulance
stories.summary: The RCMP say their underwater recovery team in Nova Scotia played a key role in recovering evidence from an Ontario air ambulance that went down off the coast of Massachusetts.

stories.title: Nova Scotia launches Support Our Troops licence plate benefiting military charity
stories.summary: Nova Scotia has unveiled a new Support our Troops specialty licence plate, with a $50 fee collected going to a charity that supports serving and former military members.

stories.title: Nova Scotia pulls amusement ride’s licence after 5 children hurt at Christmas event
stories.summary: Nova Scotia’s Labour Department has suspended the licence for a carnival ride that malfunctioned during a weekend event in Cape Breton, injuring five children.

stories.title: ‘We’ve had enough’: Groups urge Nova Scotia to act on power bill costs
stories.summary: Protesters said they're being priced out and don't believe the provincial government is doing enough to help people struggling to keep up with rising energy costs.

stories.title: Halifax councillors weigh service cuts against lower tax increase
stories.summary: Halifax Regional Council is beginning budget deliberations, as the municipality tries to balance affordability with maintaining services.

stories.title: Provinces waiting to see if Trump follows through on data centre tax threat
stories.summary: Premier Tim Houston’s office said that Trump has made similar threats before, such as his call last year for 100 per cent tariffs on foreign films that never materialized.
